issues.description: v3-beta default speaker mismatches documentation ('shubh' in code vs 'aditya' in docs/PR).
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS['bulbul:v3-beta'] sets default_speaker='shubh', but the module docstring, class docstring, SarvamTTSSpeakerV3 enum, and PR description all advertise 'aditya'. Callers relying on the documented default will get a different voice with no error, a silent and hard-to-debug surprise. Align config, enums, and docs to a single value.

issues.description: input_audio_codec silently dropped from STT _connect() kwargs, likely regressing v2.5/v3 streaming.
issues.detail: Previously connect_kwargs included 'input_audio_codec': self._input_audio_codec; the refactor removes it entirely while __init__ still accepts and stores the value, making it a silent no-op. If the Sarvam SDK uses it to interpret non-default codecs, existing users will see broken or misinterpreted audio with no deprecation notice. Restore it or document removal and drop from __init__.

issues.description: 'Ignored parameter' warnings misfire by comparing Optional[float] to literal defaults.
issues.detail: Checks like 'params.pitch != 0.0', 'params.loudness != 1.0', and 'params.temperature != 0.6' fire spuriously when the user explicitly passes None on Optional fields, and suppress legitimate warnings when the user sets the literal default. Track explicitly-set fields via Pydantic's model_fields_set instead of value comparison.

issues.description: Pace silently clamped to model range instead of raising or using model-aware validation.
issues.detail: When pace falls outside the model's range, code logs a warning and clamps, mutating user intent silently. Pydantic Field already constrains pace to 0.3-3.0, so per-model clamping is inconsistent with the schema. Either raise ValueError like other unsupported params or implement a model-aware validator, and include the clamped value in the log.

issues.description: voice_id is not validated against the model's allowed speaker list.
issues.detail: SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums and TTSModelConfig.speakers exist but __init__ accepts any voice_id string without checking membership. Passing a v2 speaker name with bulbul:v3-beta (or a typo) silently reaches the API and fails opaquely. Validate voice_id against self._config.speakers via get_speakers_for_model and raise ValueError with the allowed list.

issues.description: Backward-incompatible removal of 'bulbul:v3' alias previously accepted in code and docs.
issues.detail: The prior implementation routed both 'bulbul:v3-beta' and 'bulbul:v3' via the same branch, and the example docstring used 'bulbul:v3'. New strict validation rejects 'bulbul:v3' with ValueError, breaking users who copy-pasted from the prior docs. Add 'bulbul:v3' as an alias or call out the breaking change in the PR notes.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor to config-driven model dispatch (frozen ModelConfig tables) is a clean structural improvement, but several concrete regressions and inconsistencies need to be fixed before merge. The single P0 with full panel consensus is the v3-beta default speaker mismatch ('shubh' in config vs 'aditya' in all docs). Two further unanimous P1s: input_audio_codec silently dropped from STT _connect() kwargs, and 'ignored parameter' warnings that misfire by comparing Optional[float] to literal defaults. Remaining priorities are silent pace clamping, missing voice_id validation against the model's speaker list, and the dropped 'bulbul:v3' alias.
